newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tung considers prompt property measures.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tung considers prompt property measures.

text.p: Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa is considering measures to stabilise soaring property prices as soon as possible rather than waiting until his first policy speech in October, a local newspaper reported on Friday.
Tung was quoted by the Hong Kong Economic Times as saying the solution to high prices lay in land supply.
Officials at Tung's office were not immediately available to comment.
Property prices have been rising recently after a brief fall following the colonial government's announcement in March of measures to rein them in.
Tung will become Hong Kong's first Chief Executive when China takes back the territory from Britain on July 1.
